calibration_sources: DeepSeek-V3 Auxiliary-Loss-Free Load Balancing (Dynamic Expert Bias b_i & Node-Limited Routing M=4)
deepseek-ai/EPLB (Expert Parallelism Load Balancer: Hierarchical Packing & Redundant Physical Expert Slots)
SGLang / vLLM Zero-Downtime Expert Weight P2P Migration & Indirection Routing Table Swap

workload_baseline.model: 671B-class MoE (256 routed experts + 1 shared expert, Top-8, 58 MoE layers, +32 redundant EPLB slots)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Legacy Aux-Loss + Hard Capacity Factor Token Dropping (CF=1.25 Drops Overflow Tokens)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 传统辅助损失 (Aux-Loss) + 容量因子硬截断丢词 (CF=1.25 溢出直接跳过专家层)
tiers.mechanism: Adds auxiliary load-balance loss to training gradient (hurting specialization) and drops tokens exceeding CF=1.25

tiers.name: Tier 2: Dropless MoE without Redundancy (100% Token Retention but 4.20x Hot-Expert GPU Straggler Stall)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 无丢词 Dropless MoE 静态单副本 (保住 0% 丢词，但 63 张卡同步死等 1 张热门专家卡)
tiers.mechanism: Variable-size Block-Sparse GEMM keeps all tokens (0% drop), but 1 hot GPU processes 4.2x tokens while 63 GPUs stall at All-to-All Combine

tiers.name: Tier 3: Aux-Loss-Free Dynamic Bias Routing (b_i Sign Update) + M=4 Node-Limited Routing (Training + Static Serving)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 免辅助损失动态偏置路由 (Aux-Loss-Free b_i 更新) + M=4 节点受限路由 (零梯度干扰)
tiers.mechanism: Decouples load balancing from LM loss via gradient-free bias b_i = b_i + gamma*sign(mean - load_i) and caps each token to at most M=4 nodes

tiers.name: Tier 4: Aux-Loss-Free Routing + Dynamic EPLB (256 Logical -> 288 Physical Slots, Hierarchical Packing & Zero-Downtime P2P Swap)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 免辅助损失路由 + 动态 EPLB 热门专家冗余复制 (256逻辑→288物理槽位 + 分层装箱 + 零停机热迁移)
tiers.mechanism: Pre-allocates +32 redundant physical slots (+12.5% HBM) across 64 GPUs; clones Top-32 hot experts & rebalances every 5 min via async P2P DMA

skew_perturbation.diagnosis: Balanced domain distribution; EPLB packs node-level groups to minimize cross-node RDMA

skew_perturbation.workload: Enterprise General Assistant & RAG Traffic (Medium Skew = 2.4x)
skew_perturbation.diagnosis: Top-16 SQL/JSON experts receive 2.4x traffic; EPLB 2x replication eliminates rack straggler

skew_perturbation.workload: Daytime Coding Agent Burst (High Skew = 4.2x on Code Experts)
skew_perturbation.diagnosis: 12 code experts hit by 65% of tokens; EPLB replicates hottest experts up to 4x across nodes

skew_perturbation.workload: Math / Logic RL Rollout Storm (Extreme Skew = 5.8x on Reasoning Experts)
skew_perturbation.diagnosis: Without EPLB, 63 GPUs idle 78% of MoE step waiting on 1 symbolic-math expert GPU
